stem.text: The diagram shows two points P and Q which lie $90^{\circ}$ apart on a circle of radius $r$.
A positive point charge at the centre of the circle creates an electric field of magnitude $E$ at both P and Q.

stem.alt: Circle with points P and Q on its circumference, 90 degrees apart, a point charge marked + at its centre with dashed radial lines to P and Q and a right-angle mark at the centre, and a radius labelled r.

stem.text: Which expression gives the work done in moving a unit positive charge from P to Q?
